mapper.sql: id, owner_account_id, label, address_cipher, location_cipher, is_default, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_address (owner_account_id, label, address_cipher, location_cipher, is_default) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{label}, #{addressCipher}, #{locationCipher}, #{isDefault})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_address WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM vi_address WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_default DESC, id
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_address SET label = #{label}, address_cipher = #{addressCipher}, location_cipher = #{locationCipher}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE vi_address SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, is_default = 0, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE vi_address SET is_default = 0, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND is_default = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id != #{excludeId}

UPDATE vi_address SET is_default = #{flag}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerAccountId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL
